title: AdapterRequest
description: Request object passed to VendorAdapter.call() or VendorAdapter.stream().

model.description: Model identifier as understood by the upstream provider.

content.description: Text string for plain messages; array of content-block objects for multimodal.

maxTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate.

tools.description: Tool definitions (OpenAI tool schema convention). Only valid when adapter declares 'tools'.

responseFormat.description: Structured output format (OpenAI response_format convention). Only valid when adapter declares 'json_mode'.

reasoning.description: Reasoning effort hint. Only valid when adapter declares 'reasoning_effort'.

stream.description: When true, caller intends to consume via stream(). Only valid when adapter declares 'streaming'.

apiKey.description: API key for the upstream provider.
